concepts.label: Sidebar group
concepts.position: A dimmed STREAMS group above the footer, folded to one quiet line when all are healthy; a stream with trouble comes out as a row; clicking a row shows its log in the main pane

concepts.label: Status-bar item
concepts.position: One status-bar item next to Webhooks, dim when healthy and coloured with the worst stream's state otherwise; it opens a popover of every stream with Restart, Pause and Log; Log opens a read-only log window

concepts.label: Triggers screen
concepts.position: Streams live in the Triggers screen as trigger sources, with a detail pane (state, log, recent events with verdicts); the sidebar shows nothing when healthy, and the footer's Triggers button carries a dot and short label when a stream isn't
